descriptions.VBO:0000661: Calm and friendly with familiar people, Broholmers keep a quiet watchfulness rooted in guarding Danish farms and manor houses.
descriptions.VBO:0000663: Lively and quick to notice change, this farm companion caught rats, watched the household, and joined daily work around the yard.
descriptions.VBO:0000668: Steady and unhurried on a hunt, this pointer searches quietly while keeping close contact with its handler.
descriptions.VBO:0000670: Calm with familiar people, the Pyrenean Mastiff can sound a deep warning bark, echoing its work defending mountain flocks.
descriptions.VBO:0200003: Boldly curious and watchful, the Affenpinscher reacts quickly to unfamiliar activity, reflecting its roots as a German house dog.
descriptions.VBO:0200004: Dignified and often reserved, the Afghan Hound can switch to a keen chase, shaped by sight hunting in mountain country.
descriptions.VBO:0200007: Africanis dogs have long lived close to southern African households, helping bring cattle in and watching homesteads; local habits vary.
descriptions.VBO:0200008: Outgoing and confident, the Airedale pairs terrier courage with a versatile working past that includes scent tracking and service.
descriptions.VBO:0200009: Quietly watchful around its flock, the Akbash can make an independent, swift response when a threat breaks the calm.
descriptions.VBO:0200010: Composed and attentive, the Akita tends to bond faithfully with familiar people, carrying the quiet manner of its Japanese lineage.
descriptions.VBO:0200016: Curious and closely attached to its people, the Alaskan Klee Kai can be reserved with strangers and quick to sound an alarm.
descriptions.VBO:0200017: Often playful and friendly, the Alaskan Malamute also brings the cooperation and stamina of a heavy-load Arctic sled dog.
descriptions.VBO:0200023: Friendly in company but fearless on a trail, this Austrian hound follows wounded game through steep ground with persistence.
descriptions.VBO:0200034: Steady and confident with familiar people, the American Bulldog reflects a farm past of catching livestock and guarding property.
descriptions.VBO:0200045: Sociable around people and dogs, this coonhound becomes a persistent night hunter, voicing its progress along a raccoon trail.
descriptions.VBO:0200046: Lively and attentive to household life, the American Eskimo Dog is friendly with familiar people and alert to unfamiliar arrivals.
descriptions.VBO:0200047: Easygoing in company yet eager on a scent, the American Foxhound was shaped for enduring pack work on long fox trails.
descriptions.VBO:0200049: Alert and curious, this hairless terrier retains its ratting ancestors’ drive, now often expressed through activity and sport.
descriptions.VBO:0200055: Confident and good-natured with familiar people, this terrier brings courage, agility, and close attention to its surroundings.
descriptions.VBO:0200059: An enthusiastic, cooperative hunting partner, the American Water Spaniel retrieves from small boats and keeps working on land.
descriptions.VBO:0200062: Composed and watchful, the Anatolian Shepherd may judge a threat independently after long days ranging with livestock.
descriptions.VBO:0200068: Lively and vigilant, the Appenzeller helped drive Swiss cattle, watch farms, and raise an alarm when something changed.
descriptions.VBO:0200077: The Armenian Gampr watches for threats and decides when to respond, reflecting independent flock-guarding work in the highlands.
descriptions.VBO:0200083: Loyal and attentive to unfamiliar movement, the Aidi watched Atlas Mountain camps and flocks rather than moving sheep.
descriptions.VBO:0200088: Intensely alert and devoted to work, the Australian Cattle Dog was shaped to keep stock moving across unfenced country.
descriptions.VBO:0200090: Quick to read a flock, the Kelpie gathers and drives sheep through open country and yards with tireless attention to movement.
descriptions.VBO:0200095: Attentive to tiny shifts in livestock movement, the Australian Shepherd works closely with a handler through long ranch days.
descriptions.VBO:0200097: Loyal and watchful, the Stumpy Tail Cattle Dog was selected to control stock and keep cattle moving across hard country.
descriptions.VBO:0200098: Lively and persistent, the Australian Terrier served as a practical farm helper while living closely with its people.
descriptions.VBO:0200100: Persistent and agreeable, this Austrian hound voices its course on a hare trail and follows wounded game through rough ground.
descriptions.VBO:0200103: Playful with familiar people but alert at the homestead, the Austrian Pinscher carries an old farm-watchdog tradition.
descriptions.VBO:0200106: Gentle and affectionate with its handler, the Auvergne Pointer works difficult French hunting ground with a keen nose.
descriptions.VBO:0200108: Reserved with strangers and gentle among trusted people, the Azawakh shared Sahel camp life while hunting and watching for threats.
descriptions.VBO:0200110: Bakharwal dogs accompany high-pasture flocks in Jammu and Kashmir, watching sheep and goats through seasonal mountain travel.
descriptions.VBO:0200118: Cheerful and willing, the Barbado da Terceira learns quickly and stays close to its people while gathering Azorean cattle.
descriptions.VBO:0200120: Independent and keenly alert, the Basenji has fastidious habits and a chortling yodel in place of a conventional bark.
descriptions.VBO:0200121: The Iletsua variety works closely with its person and marks territory strongly, rooted in Basque pastoral herding.
descriptions.VBO:0200124: Affectionate away from a hunt, this Basset can become single-minded on rabbit or hare scent, following it with a resonant voice.
descriptions.VBO:0200125: Sociable with familiar people yet persistent on a trail, this Breton hound pursues quarry through difficult ground.
descriptions.VBO:0200126: Placid and affectionate off duty, the Basset Hound becomes a patient, deep-voiced pack hunter on a hare trail.
descriptions.VBO:0200131: Merry and even-tempered in company, the Beagle turns persistent when hare scent calls its pack-hunting instincts into play.
descriptions.VBO:0200134: Lively and confident, Bearded Collies bring alert initiative to the steady work of moving sheep.
descriptions.VBO:0200136: Self-assured and composed, the Beauceron can both move and guard a flock while responding to a shepherd’s direction.
descriptions.VBO:0200137: Mild and affectionate at rest, the Bedlington Terrier can turn spirited and courageous when a sporting instinct wakes.
descriptions.VBO:0200145: Watchful and energetic, the Groenendael stays close to its people and can shift quickly from minding flocks to guarding.
descriptions.VBO:0200146: Watchful and ready to act, the Laekenois reflects farm work that switched between moving flocks and guarding property.
descriptions.VBO:0200147: Intensely alert and closely attached to its people, the Malinois combines herding attention with stamina for scent and service work.
descriptions.VBO:0200148: Alert and confident, the Tervueren works closely with people, responding quickly while moving flocks or guarding a farm.
descriptions.VBO:0200154: Patient and attentive among sheep, the Bergamasco makes close decisions while driving and guarding northern Italian herds.
descriptions.VBO:0200158: Even-tempered and fearless, the Berger Picard stays close to its household while drawing on old sheep-and-cattle work.
descriptions.VBO:0200161: Steady and good-natured with familiar people, the Bernese Mountain Dog once shifted among guarding, cattle, and cart work.
descriptions.VBO:0200163: Cheerful and sociable, the Bichon Frise enjoys close household routines and generally is not a frequent barker.
descriptions.VBO:0200168: Outgoing with people and other hounds, this coonhound follows raccoon scent with persistence and calls when quarry is treed.
descriptions.VBO:0200174: Composed and responsive, the Black Russian Terrier can shift into controlled defense and settle again afterward.
descriptions.VBO:0200175: Gentle in company yet relentless on a scent, the Bloodhound used its extraordinary nose in hunts and searches for missing people.
descriptions.VBO:0200185: Confident and devoted, the Boerboel keeps a composed watch over familiar people and property, reflecting South African homestead guarding.
descriptions.VBO:0200186: Lively yet controlled, the Bohemian Shepherd stays alert and responsive, drawing on a Czech tradition of guarding holdings and moving cattle.
descriptions.VBO:0200189: Calm and closely attached to familiar people, the Bolognese has long excelled at quiet companionship, once prized in European courts.
descriptions.VBO:0200193: Keen and quick to learn, the Border Collie reads moving sheep and responds precisely to a handler, persisting through long days with stock.
descriptions.VBO:0200194: Active and game, the Border Terrier kept pace with horses on the border hunt, then pursued quarry into narrow earths with determination.
descriptions.VBO:0200197: Calm with people but quick to react to movement, the Borzoi hunted hare and fox in Russia, shifting from measured search to full gallop.
descriptions.VBO:0200204: Lively and friendly, the Boston Terrier joins household activity with bright curiosity; this American breed was developed for companionship.
descriptions.VBO:0200208: Calm, thoughtful and fearless, the Bouvier des Flandres moved cattle across Flanders farms, adjusting to both stock and handler.
descriptions.VBO:0200210: Playful with familiar people yet watchful, the Boxer combines a sociable manner with the courage of its game-holding ancestors.
descriptions.VBO:0200214: Eager and attentive, the Boykin Spaniel worked closely with South Carolina hunters to find, flush and retrieve birds from swamp country.
descriptions.VBO:0200215: Docile and responsive to training, the Bracco Italiano covers varied ground at a broad trot, points birds and retrieves for hunters.
descriptions.VBO:0200231: Lively and warm with familiar people, Brazilian Terriers can be wary of newcomers; farm work included hunting small game and keeping watch.
descriptions.VBO:0200232: Calm away from a trail but persistent on scent, the Brazilian Tracker can flush and corner game alone or alongside other hounds.
descriptions.VBO:0200234: Courageous and composed, the Briard drove and guarded French flocks before serving the army in both world wars.
descriptions.VBO:0200238: Sociable and attentive, the Brittany searches independently for birds, then points and retrieves in close cooperation with a hunter.
descriptions.VBO:0200255: Playful and friendly with a stubborn streak, the Bull Terrier pairs a sociable, mischievous manner with longstanding courage.
descriptions.VBO:0200258: Bold and affectionate, the Bulldog carries determination from its difficult bull-baiting past into a calmer modern companion role.
descriptions.VBO:0200261: Alert and faithful, the Bullmastiff was bred to help British gamekeepers stop poachers at night through strength and sound judgment.
descriptions.VBO:0200267: Active and cheerful, the Cairn Terrier pursues a task fearlessly, recalling its vermin-hunting roots among Highland stone and brush.
descriptions.VBO:0200270: Lively and versatile, the Calupoh bonds closely with family but may take time with strangers; its modern identity is Mexican.
descriptions.VBO:0200271: Vigilant yet calm with its handler, the Campeiro Bulldog helped locate, hold and move difficult cattle in southern Brazil.
descriptions.VBO:0200273: Watchful and at home in farm routines, the Can de Palleiro helped Galician families drive livestock and guard animals or property.
descriptions.VBO:0200274: Watchful and quick to react, the Canaan Dog bonds with its people while staying wary of strangers, a legacy of security and warning work.
descriptions.VBO:0200275: Curious and quietly affectionate with people, the Canadian Eskimo Dog worked in teams hauling sleds and packs for Inuit communities.
descriptions.VBO:0200290: Alert and active with a steady manner, the Cardigan Welsh Corgi developed in cattle-driving work that demanded attention and endurance.
descriptions.VBO:0200299: Vigilant and devoted to its shepherd, the Catalan Sheepdog uses initiative to move flocks and bring straying animals back into line.
descriptions.VBO:0200304: Self-assured and watchful, the Caucasian Shepherd Dog makes independent judgments while guarding, yet stays attached to its own people.
descriptions.VBO:0200309: Affectionate and friendly with an active streak, the Cavalier King Charles Spaniel unites a lap-companion past with sporting-spaniel roots.
descriptions.VBO:0200321: Quietly self-assured, the Central Asian Shepherd Dog judges threats independently, drawing on long work guarding herds, caravans and homes.
descriptions.VBO:0200323: Cheerful and calm with familiar people, the Cesky Terrier can be reserved with strangers; it was developed for fox and badger hunting.
descriptions.VBO:0200326: Courageous and affectionate with a love of water, the Chesapeake Bay Retriever persists through cold swims and repeated waterfowl retrieves.
descriptions.VBO:0200338: Alert, lively and self-assured, the Chihuahua carries bold, terrier-like confidence in a breed shaped chiefly for companionship.
descriptions.VBO:0200339: Alert and lively, the long-haired Chihuahua often shows self-reliant, terrier-like confidence; companionship remains its central role.
descriptions.VBO:0200344: Calm and affectionate with its family but aloof with strangers, the Chinese Chongqing Dog was kept for scent-led hunting and home protection.
descriptions.VBO:0200345: Affectionate and playful, the Chinese Crested often seeks a high perch to watch the room and can channel that lively attention into agility.
descriptions.VBO:0200346: Affectionate and playful, the Hairless Chinese Crested may watch from a high perch; its exposed skin needs care in cold and strong sun.
descriptions.VBO:0200347: Playful and affectionate, the Powder Puff Chinese Crested likes to stay close and watch from a high perch; it is the fully coated variety.
descriptions.VBO:0200351: Calm and independent but loyal to its own family, the Chinese Shar-Pei retains quiet watchfulness from a hunting and guarding past.
descriptions.VBO:0200353: Calm and willing, the Chinook cooperates with other sled dogs, blending freight-hauling strength with the pace of a racing team.
descriptions.VBO:0200354: Chippiparai dogs observed near Tirunelveli were affectionate with familiar people and alert to strangers; local hunters pursue hare with them.
descriptions.VBO:0200361: Quiet and self-possessed, the Chow Chow is loyal to familiar people but reserved with strangers, reflecting a long guarding history.
descriptions.VBO:0200364: Balanced and courageous, the Cimarrón Uruguayo moved from free-ranging survival to purposeful estate guarding and cattle work.
descriptions.VBO:0200365: Resolute in pursuit yet affectionate with familiar people, the Cirneco dell'Etna uses scent to find rabbits in Sicily's rocky crevices.
descriptions.VBO:0200366: Steady and kindly, the Clumber Spaniel works quietly through cover, relying on its nose and patient pace more than speed.
descriptions.VBO:0200376: Friendly and active, the Rough Collie pairs sociability with watchfulness; its Scottish shepherd roots still show in herding ability.
descriptions.VBO:0200377: Outgoing and quick to learn, the Smooth Collie bonds closely with family and may alert to unfamiliar sounds before settling.
descriptions.VBO:0200389: Cheerful and sociable, the Coton de Tulear enjoys people and other dogs; its even-tempered companion history began in Madagascar.
descriptions.VBO:0200392: Devoted and lively without nervousness, the Croatian Sheepdog reacts quickly to turn and redirect moving livestock.
descriptions.VBO:0200397: Steady and confident with familiar people, the Curly Coated Retriever works independently through difficult cover to retrieve game.
descriptions.VBO:0200402: Quick to react and loyal to familiar people, the Czechoslovakian Wolfdog has stamina and caution around strangers.
descriptions.VBO:0200406: Friendly yet persistent on a trail, the Dachshund tracks, flushes game and follows quarry both above and below ground.
descriptions.VBO:0200427: Lively and independent, the Dalmatian has a marked hunting instinct and an affinity for water and outdoor activity.
descriptions.VBO:0200429: Determined and persistent at work, the Dandie Dinmont Terrier also shows sensitivity and affection with its people.
descriptions.VBO:0200442: Calm and devoted with familiar people, the Doberman stays attentive and responsive, traits valued in protective and police work.
descriptions.VBO:0200445: Courageous and steady under pressure, the Dogo Argentino follows big game by scent, often staying quiet on the trail.
descriptions.VBO:0200447: Calm and loyal with familiar people, the Dogo Guatemalteco watches strangers closely before relaxing when they are welcomed.
descriptions.VBO:0200450: Watchful and courageous yet calm with its people, the Dogue de Bordeaux has a long Aquitaine history of guarding and hunting.
descriptions.VBO:0200453: Attentive to its hunter, the Drentsche Patrijshond searches for birds, points and retrieves without ranging far away.
descriptions.VBO:0200454: Keen and even-tempered, the Drever follows deer scent steadily, at a pace that lets hunters keep up on foot.
descriptions.VBO:0200456: Sociable and trusting, the Dunker is a robust Norwegian hare hound with a steady manner in the field.
descriptions.VBO:0200463: Alert and independent, the Dutch Shepherd once kept sheep away from crops like a living fence while working with its shepherd.
descriptions.VBO:0200486: Gentle and affectionate with familiar people, the English Cocker Spaniel becomes enthusiastic when flushing birds from thick cover.
descriptions.VBO:0200490: Friendly and sociable, the English Foxhound works with a pack, following fox scent over long mounted hunts.
descriptions.VBO:0200495: Friendly with people yet keen for game, the English Setter searches for birds and holds a point until the hunter approaches.
descriptions.VBO:0200497: Eager and cooperative, the English Springer Spaniel works close to a handler to find and flush game, then retrieve it.
descriptions.VBO:0200499: Alert without undue nervousness, the English Toy Terrier retains quick terrier attention from its ratting history.
descriptions.VBO:0200502: Lively and confident with familiar people, the Entlebuch Cattle Dog drove Swiss stock and watched farms, staying alert to changes.
descriptions.VBO:0200508: Friendly and even-tempered, the Estonian Hound follows scent through difficult forest country, using its voice to guide hunters.
descriptions.VBO:0200509: Close to its shepherd but cautious with strangers, the Estrela Mountain Dog guarded Portuguese flocks between valleys and high pasture.
descriptions.VBO:0200512: Calm and closely attached to family, the Eurasier watches quietly and tends to be reserved rather than pushy with strangers.
descriptions.VBO:0200519: Docile and sensitive yet capable of independent decisions, the Field Spaniel searches cover, flushes game and retrieves it.
descriptions.VBO:0200520: Calm and self-assured with familiar people, the Fila Brasileiro remains vigilant in unfamiliar situations, reflecting its guarding work.
descriptions.VBO:0200523: Courageous and calm with a friendly manner, the Finnish Lapphund grew from Sámi dogs used to herd reindeer.
descriptions.VBO:0200526: Lively and independent, the Finnish Spitz locates birds in trees and barks to mark their position for a hunter.
descriptions.VBO:0200528: Friendly, confident and ready for work, the Flat-Coated Retriever brings optimism and stamina to retrieving game.
descriptions.VBO:0200529: Keenly alert and quick to react, the Formosan Mountain Dog reflects Taiwan's forest hunting tradition.
descriptions.VBO:0200550: Sociable and close to its handler, the French Water Dog eagerly searches marshes, flushes birds and retrieves in cold water.
descriptions.VBO:0200557: Reserved away from a chase, the Galgo Español becomes lively in open-field hare pursuit, relying on sight and sustained effort.
descriptions.VBO:0200563: Watchful and independently minded, the Georgian Shepherd guarded people and holdings across demanding mountain country.
descriptions.VBO:0200577: Steadily attentive and responsive to a handler, the German Shepherd Dog moved from herding into protection and service work.
descriptions.VBO:0200583: Firm and balanced in temperament, the German Shorthaired Pointer points game, follows trails and retrieves after the shot.
descriptions.VBO:0200602: Steady around gunfire, the German Wirehaired Pointer stays focused while searching, pointing and retrieving across field, forest and water.
descriptions.VBO:0200604: Energetic yet composed, the Giant Schnauzer brings loyalty and endurance from its cattle-driving roots to demanding work.
descriptions.VBO:0200609: Courageous but relatively quiet for a terrier, the Glen of Imaal Terrier hunted foxes and badgers in its Irish valley.
descriptions.VBO:0200610: Friendly and eager to cooperate, the Golden Retriever works beside people to find and bring back game on land or water.
descriptions.VBO:0200613: Bold, outgoing and kindly, the Gordon Setter searches for birds and holds a point for a hunter.
descriptions.VBO:0200615: Courageous and independent on scent, the Grand Basset Griffon Vendéen pursues hare through western French scrub with a ringing voice.
descriptions.VBO:0200623: Affectionate and attached to its people, the Great Dane can be reserved with strangers; its history includes boar hunting and guarding.
descriptions.VBO:0200629: Independent in judgment yet attached to its flock, the Great Pyrenees watches mountain animals and deters predators.
descriptions.VBO:0200631: Self-confident and watchful, the Greater Swiss Mountain Dog helped Swiss farms move cattle, guard property and pull loads.
descriptions.VBO:0200636: Bold and energetic in Arctic work, the Greenland Dog pulls sledges and retains a strong hunting instinct.
descriptions.VBO:0200638: Gentle and affectionate away from pursuit, the Greyhound makes quick decisions at speed when coursing hare by sight.
descriptions.VBO:0200655: Friendly off duty, the Hamiltonstövare becomes a determined solo scent hound, announcing a hare or fox trail with its voice.
descriptions.VBO:0200662: Playful and affectionate, the Havanese takes an active interest in household life and once served as a small alarm dog.
descriptions.VBO:0200667: Persistent on scent, the Hellenic Hound voices its progress across Greek lowlands and rocky mountains, alone or with a pack.
descriptions.VBO:0200670: Himalayan Sheepdogs guard livestock in mountain country; Gaddi dogs specifically travel with herders between seasonal pastures.
descriptions.VBO:0200671: Faithful and alert, the Hokkaido worked with Ainu bear hunters, responding to its handler while showing boldness in the chase.
descriptions.VBO:0200674: Confident and devoted to familiar people, the Hovawart watches property and uses its nose in tracking and rescue work.
descriptions.VBO:0200678: Watchful and sensible, the Hungarian Greyhound pursues game with stamina and can show a protective instinct at home.
descriptions.VBO:0200683: The Huntaway drives New Zealand sheep with a deep, repeated bark, controlling flocks at a distance across yards and hills.
descriptions.VBO:0200688: Alert to sound, scent and movement, the Ibizan Hound hunts rabbits over Balearic rocky ground, sometimes coordinating with other dogs.
descriptions.VBO:0200692: Cheerful and curious, the Icelandic Sheepdog helps round up livestock and uses its bark in herding and when visitors arrive.
descriptions.VBO:0200695: The Indian Pariah Dog is a living village landrace; rural dogs may watch homesteads or help move cattle alongside people.
descriptions.VBO:0200696: The Indian Spitz is a companion with a distinct place in Indian homes and dog shows, though clubs have named and classified it differently.
descriptions.VBO:0200700: Friendly and high-spirited, the Irish Red and White Setter works with determination and courage as a distinct bird dog.
descriptions.VBO:0200702: Keen and energetic in the field but affectionate with familiar people, the Irish Setter searches and sets birds with stamina.
descriptions.VBO:0200704: Loyal and affectionate yet ready to stand its ground, the Irish Terrier served as a hunter, guard and wartime messenger.
descriptions.VBO:0200705: Eager and bold in wildfowling, the Irish Water Spaniel searches heavy cover and retrieves from water, then shows playfulness with its people.
descriptions.VBO:0200706: Gentle with people and dogs, the Irish Wolfhound has a courageous past pursuing wolves, boar and deer in Ireland.
descriptions.VBO:0200709: Persistent on a hunt but gentle with familiar people, the Istrian Short-Haired Hound voices game across Croatia's stony Karst.
descriptions.VBO:0200710: Gentle with familiar people yet persistent on scent, the Istrian Wire-Haired Hound voices hare and fox over stony hills.
descriptions.VBO:0200713: Lively and affectionate in close company, the Italian Greyhound retains a sighthound's swift reactions alongside its courtly companion past.
descriptions.VBO:0200721: Patient and sociable but tough in the field, the Italian Spinone pushes through thorny cover and retrieves from cold water.
descriptions.VBO:0200724: Lively, fearless and friendly, the Jack Russell Terrier pursues fox quarry above ground and can follow it below.
descriptions.VBO:0200732: Bold and persistent on quarry, the Jagdterrier works above and below ground but can be sociable with familiar people.
descriptions.VBO:0200733: Energetic and courageous in an elk hunt, the Jämthund can also be stoically calm while finding and baying game for long stretches.
descriptions.VBO:0200735: Clever and mild, the Japanese Chin has spent centuries in close companionship in aristocratic Japanese households.
descriptions.VBO:0200740: Cheerful and keen-sensed, the Japanese Spitz quickly notices activity around the home and engages with nearby people.
descriptions.VBO:0200741: Lively and swift, the Japanese Terrier combines quick terrier responses with a close companion role shaped in Japan's port cities.
descriptions.VBO:0200744: Alert and deliberate, the Jindo bonds strongly with familiar people and retains a pronounced hunting instinct and sense of direction.
descriptions.VBO:0200747: Keen and highly alert, the Kai Ken hunted boar and deer in Japan's steep Kai mountains, including work alongside other dogs.
descriptions.VBO:0200749: Steady and independent, the Kangal Dog watches Turkish sheep through long quiet stretches, judging when a threat needs a response.
descriptions.VBO:0200751: The Kanni is a southern Tamil Nadu sighthound known for fast hunting pursuit and companionship with local families.
descriptions.VBO:0200754: Eager and independent yet cooperative with a hunter, the Karelian Bear Dog tracks elk or bear and marks stopped game by barking.
descriptions.VBO:0200758: Courageous and attached to its own people, the Karst Shepherd Dog independently watched flocks in Slovenia's Karst region.
descriptions.VBO:0200759: Outgoing and friendly, the Keeshond was both companion and alert watchdog aboard Dutch canal barges.
descriptions.VBO:0200764: Keen and determined, the Kerry Blue Terrier took on vermin, badger, and otter in demanding Irish farm work.
descriptions.VBO:0200765: Gentle and affectionate, the King Charles Spaniel has long been prized for close companionship in England.
descriptions.VBO:0200772: Watchful and quick to learn, the Kintamani-Bali Dog is loyal with familiar people and rooted in highland village life.
descriptions.VBO:0200774: Alert and responsive, the Kishu Ken brings endurance and fidelity to boar hunting in Japan’s Kishu mountains.
descriptions.VBO:0200778: In a Theni district study, Kombai dogs were watchful toward strangers and responsive to familiar handlers, fitting local guarding work.
descriptions.VBO:0200779: Decisive and independently watchful, the Komondor keeps an especially active night guard around flocks and property.
descriptions.VBO:0200786: Spirited and adaptable, the Kromfohrländer was developed as a companion and generally has only a modest hunting instinct.
descriptions.VBO:0200793: Brave and self-confident, the Kuvasz guarded Hungarian flocks and property even when people were out of reach.
descriptions.VBO:0200800: Outgoing and cooperative, the Labrador brings a keen nose, enthusiasm for water, and a gentle grip to retrieving.
descriptions.VBO:0200807: Bold and friendly, the Lakeland Terrier was shaped to pursue foxes across the rocky fells where sheep were at risk.
descriptions.VBO:0200808: Cheerful and affectionate, the Lancashire Heeler worked cattle and turned the same quick attention to farm vermin.
descriptions.VBO:0200814: Calm and willing away from work, the Lapponian Herder may bark readily while moving reindeer with Sámi herders.
descriptions.VBO:0200816: Lively without nervousness, the Large Münsterländer searches, points, and retrieves across field, forest, and water.
descriptions.VBO:0200819: Composed and playful with familiar people, the Leonberger became a steady companion and watch dog.
descriptions.VBO:0200824: Alert and self-possessed, the Lhasa Apso tends to be steady with its own circle and more distant with strangers.
descriptions.VBO:0200836: Affectionate and attentive, the Löwchen watches people closely and can settle quietly, reflecting centuries as a court companion.
descriptions.VBO:0200856: Lively and affectionate near its people, the Maltese has filled a close companion role around the Mediterranean for centuries.
descriptions.VBO:0200862: Keen and alert yet devoted in company, the Manchester Terrier carries a ratting history from its namesake English city.
descriptions.VBO:0200865: Perceptive and devoted to its charge, the Maremma Sheepdog guarded flocks through seasonal moves across central Italy.
descriptions.VBO:0200867: Quiet and affectionate with familiar people, the Mastiff retains watchful courage from Britain’s long guard-dog tradition.
descriptions.VBO:0200880: Devoted and energetic, the Miniature American Shepherd keeps a persistent herding instinct and watches unfamiliar arrivals.
descriptions.VBO:0200882: Fearlessly playful and sometimes stubborn, the Miniature Bull Terrier can be amusingly determined in close company.
descriptions.VBO:0200893: Lively and self-assured, the Miniature Pinscher is quick to notice its surroundings yet even in familiar company.
descriptions.VBO:0200896: Alert and fearless, the Miniature Schnauzer notices activity around the home, echoing its rough-haired farm-dog roots.
descriptions.VBO:0200906: Balanced and attached to its handler, this Montenegrin hound follows scent steadily through rugged Balkan country.
descriptions.VBO:0200919: Known for loyalty and a protective nature, the Mucuchies also carries the Venezuelan memory of Bolívar’s companion Nevado.
descriptions.VBO:0200920: Valued for speed and stamina, the Mudhol Hound pursued game across the Deccan and kept watch near village homes.
descriptions.VBO:0200921: Quick to learn and courageous with livestock, the Mudi can switch from close herding to watching property.
descriptions.VBO:0200930: Steady and loyal, the Neapolitan Mastiff keeps a quiet watch around homes, reflecting southern Italian guarding work.
descriptions.VBO:0200932: Alert but not needlessly noisy, the Kooikerhondje lures ducks through reed screens by flashing its tail; it does not retrieve them.
descriptions.VBO:0200934: Known for wavering, musical howls, the New Guinea Singing Dog has elusive highland relatives whose habits remain hard to observe.
descriptions.VBO:0200935: Working quietly, the New Zealand Heading Dog circles wide and controls sheep with movement and a fixed gaze.
descriptions.VBO:0200938: Gentle and composed with a joyful side, the Newfoundland once hauled loads on land and helped people in water.
descriptions.VBO:0200945: Boldly curious and companionable, the Norfolk Terrier keeps the persistence of an East Anglian farm vermin hunter.
descriptions.VBO:0200948: Lively and vocal, the Norrbottenspets is known for barking at forest birds in trees during a hunt.
descriptions.VBO:0200953: Courageous, energetic, and friendly, the Norwegian Buhund helped herd livestock and watch over farmsteads.
descriptions.VBO:0200955: Courageous and agile, the Norwegian Elkhound can bark, dodge, and circle moose until a hunter reaches it.
descriptions.VBO:0200956: Brave yet quietly cooperative, the Black Norwegian Elkhound tracks elk and deer on a lead close to its handler.
descriptions.VBO:0200962: Busy, fearless, and companionable, the Norwich Terrier retains a keen interest in its surroundings from farm vermin work.
descriptions.VBO:0200964: Playful movement near shore draws ducks closer; then this eager retriever fetches them from land or water.
descriptions.VBO:0200969: Steady and biddable, the Old English Sheepdog cooperated with people through long days of country sheep work.
descriptions.VBO:0200980: Amiable off duty, the Otterhound follows scent over bank and water, giving a deep bay when a trail turns promising.
descriptions.VBO:0200987: Confident and energetic, the Parson Russell Terrier brings fox-working boldness to agile pursuit below ground.
descriptions.VBO:0200989: Patagonian Sheepdogs still manage sheep and sometimes cattle on distant Chilean farms, shaped by generations of local work.
descriptions.VBO:0200994: Fearless and loyal with familiar people, the Pekingese combines close companionship with dignified reserve toward strangers.
descriptions.VBO:0200995: Bold and outgoing, the Pembroke Welsh Corgi keeps moving around larger livestock while watching its handler.
descriptions.VBO:0201004: Affectionate with familiar people but cautious with strangers, this Peruvian dog combines companionship with alert watchfulness.
descriptions.VBO:0201016: Playful with familiar people, the Pharaoh Hound hunts small Maltese game by sight, scent, and hearing among rocky fields.
descriptions.VBO:0201029: Gentle in company but intent in the field, the Pointer holds a still, directed signal when it finds game.
descriptions.VBO:0201032: Self-assured and sometimes reserved, the Polish Greyhound brings swift reactions and tireless pursuit to the chase.
descriptions.VBO:0201035: Lively and vigilant, this Polish sheepdog moves flocks while watching both the shepherd and nearby activity.
descriptions.VBO:0201043: Lively and quick to learn, the Pomeranian raises an alarm when household activity changes.
descriptions.VBO:0201048: Loyal and quick to learn, the Poodle carries cooperation from waterfowl retrieving into work and play.
descriptions.VBO:0201064: The Porcelaine keeps a small-game scent trail moving through French hunting country, driving quarry toward waiting hunters.
descriptions.VBO:0201067: Watchful and resourceful, Podengos vary in hunting style, from larger game pursuit to searching rabbit holes and rocks.
descriptions.VBO:0201071: Lively and focused on shepherd and herd, this Portuguese worker kept varied livestock together across Alentejo pastures.
descriptions.VBO:0201077: Vigorous and independent, the Portuguese Water Dog carried messages between fishing boats and retrieved gear from the sea.
descriptions.VBO:0201084: Gentle with familiar people but curious and quick, the Prague Ratter retains an old instinct for catching rats.
descriptions.VBO:0201087: Calm between tasks, the Pudelpointer searches, points, and retrieves across field, forest, and water.
descriptions.VBO:0201089: Lively, happy, and even-tempered, the Pug has long thrived in close companionship, from China to European courts.
descriptions.VBO:0201102: Lively and quick to learn, the Puli carries a watchful streak from its Hungarian sheep-herding past.
descriptions.VBO:0201105: Bold, busy, and vocal, the Pumi turned Hungarian livestock and sounded an alarm around the farm.
descriptions.VBO:0201109: In one documented hunting tradition, groups of Pungsan Dogs surround large quarry and bark to hold it for a hunter.
descriptions.VBO:0201122: Around Rajapalayam, local households kept these dogs to watch farms and respond to unfamiliar activity.
descriptions.VBO:0201125: Curious and quick to learn, the Rat Terrier can turn from friendly company to fearless pursuit of farm vermin.
descriptions.VBO:0201132: Even-tempered and affectionate, the Redbone follows raccoon scent and signals when quarry is treed.
descriptions.VBO:0201135: Composed and reserved with strangers, the Ridgeback historically tracked game in small groups and held it until a hunter arrived.
descriptions.VBO:0201137: Affectionate and keen to follow scent, the Lagotto shifted from marsh bird retrieval to finding underground truffles.
descriptions.VBO:0201141: Calm with familiar people, the Mioritic Shepherd shows courage when guarding Carpathian flocks from predators.
descriptions.VBO:0201143: Self-assured and eager to work, the Rottweiler moved cattle, guarded, and pulled loads around Rottweil.
descriptions.VBO:0201151: Cheerful and curious, the Russian Toy keeps close watch on its people and carries a revived Russian companion lineage.
descriptions.VBO:0201160: Friendly and watchful, Saint Bernards once found travelers lost in snow or fog near a mountain hospice.
descriptions.VBO:0201171: Independent and dignified, the Saluki often greets strangers with reserve and comes from Middle Eastern sight hunting.
descriptions.VBO:0201174: Lively and sociable, Samoyeds worked beside northern communities in herding, hunting, and sledge travel.
descriptions.VBO:0201180: Reliable and protective, the Šarplaninac guarded Balkan cattle herds with an even, considered response to threats.
descriptions.VBO:0201181: Cheerful and watchful, the Schapendoes brings quick turns and an independent mind to Dutch sheep work.
descriptions.VBO:0201184: Curious and alert, the Schipperke investigates closed doors and unfamiliar visitors, often giving a sharp alarm.
descriptions.VBO:0201185: Playful with familiar people and alert to intruders, the Schnauzer once kept stables free of rodents.
descriptions.VBO:0201195: Gentle and dignified in company, the Scottish Deerhound brings speed and persistence to red-deer coursing.
descriptions.VBO:0201198: Loyal but independent, the Scottish Terrier meets the world with reserve and persists when exploring quarry underground.
descriptions.VBO:0201200: Fearless at work but friendly in company, the Sealyham Terrier was shaped for hard Welsh vermin and otter work.
descriptions.VBO:0201207: Lively and kind-natured, the Serbian Hound grows tenacious on a scent trail, using a clear voice through the chase.
descriptions.VBO:0201217: Responsive with familiar people but reserved at first with strangers, the Sheltie keeps close watch on movement from island sheep work.
descriptions.VBO:0201220: Keenly alert and attached to familiar people, the Shiba Inu carries a hunting heritage from Japan’s mountain country.
descriptions.VBO:0201223: Friendly and independent, the Shih Tzu brings a self-possessed manner to a long history of palace companionship.
descriptions.VBO:0201225: Keen and energetic, the Shikoku responds to its handler while pursuing boar across steep Kochi mountain ground.
descriptions.VBO:0201233: Outgoing and gentle with people, the Siberian Husky thrives in cooperative harness work over long distances.
descriptions.VBO:0201237: Active and courageous, the Silky Terrier investigates movement quickly, carrying Australian terrier instincts into companionship.
descriptions.VBO:0201240: Closely bonded with its person and sometimes reserved with strangers, the Skye Terrier once pursued quarry among island rocks.
descriptions.VBO:0201242: Attached to its own people and dignified at home, the Sloughi brings a keen chase instinct to North African open ground.
descriptions.VBO:0201258: Lively and sociable, the Smooth Fox Terrier reacts quickly to a challenge, reflecting fox, rat, and rabbit work.
descriptions.VBO:0201278: Affectionate with familiar people yet resolute on guard, the Spanish Mastiff defended Merino flocks on seasonal routes.
descriptions.VBO:0201280: Lively and watchful, the Spanish Water Dog learned varied work beside people, from herding to fishing and hunting.
descriptions.VBO:0201293: Affectionate but independent, the Stabijhoun pointed game, guarded Frisian yards, and caught moles and polecats.
descriptions.VBO:0201296: Playful and affectionate with familiar people, the Staffordshire Bull Terrier retains terrier courage and watchfulness.
descriptions.VBO:0201309: Kindly yet persistent on a scent, the Sussex Spaniel gives voice in thick cover so its hunter can follow.
descriptions.VBO:0201315: Alert and affectionate, the Swedish Lapphund worked with Sámi reindeer and also took on hunting and watch duties.
descriptions.VBO:0201316: Alert and fearless, the Swedish Vallhund works close to cattle heels with confidence around much larger animals.
descriptions.VBO:0201331: Persistent on highland hunts, the Taigan can pursue game alongside a Kyrgyz golden eagle.
descriptions.VBO:0201342: Quick and inquisitive, the Tenterfield Terrier took on Australian farm vermin and later tracking and earthdog work.
descriptions.VBO:0201347: Alert and loyal with familiar people, the Thai Bangkaew Dog carries a watchful household tradition from its namesake village.
descriptions.VBO:0201348: Active and strongly attached to its people, the Thai Ridgeback hunted, watched, and traveled with carts in eastern Thailand.
descriptions.VBO:0201351: Territorial and loyal to familiar people, the Tibetan Mastiff guards with patience and independent judgment.
descriptions.VBO:0201352: Alert and independent, the Tibetan Spaniel watched from monastery walls and barked at unusual arrivals.
descriptions.VBO:0201353: Lively with familiar people but sometimes reserved at first, the Tibetan Terrier was a companion and watchful travel partner.
descriptions.VBO:0201356: Calm and affectionate with familiar people, the Tornjak becomes resolute when guarding mountain flocks and farmyards.
descriptions.VBO:0201361: Quick and eager to learn, the Toy Fox Terrier ranged from American farm ratting to circus performances.
descriptions.VBO:0201374: Active and alert, the Treeing Walker follows raccoon scent through night hunts and voices when quarry is treed.
descriptions.VBO:0201389: Friendly and eager to learn, the Vizsla stays close to its handler while finding, pointing, and retrieving game.
descriptions.VBO:0201390: Lively and playful, the Volpino Italiano stayed close to people and announced strangers for traveling Italian carters.
descriptions.VBO:0201401: Steady and persistent, the Weimaraner searches, points, and follows up after the shot on land or water.
descriptions.VBO:0201411: Merry and kind with familiar people, the Welsh Springer persists through rough cover to flush game.
descriptions.VBO:0201412: Fearless on difficult quarry yet affectionate in company, the Welsh Terrier pursued fox, badger, and otter.
descriptions.VBO:0201415: Cheerful and self-reliant, the Westie keeps the courage and curiosity of Scottish rough-country vermin work.
descriptions.VBO:0201419: Self-willed and watchful, the Wetterhoun hunted around Frisian waterways while guarding the yard.
descriptions.VBO:0201421: Gentle and affectionate at home, the Whippet turns intensely focused when the urge to chase takes hold.
descriptions.VBO:0201423: Balanced and friendly, the White Swiss Shepherd stays attentive to its people and eager for activity and sport.
descriptions.VBO:0201424: Alert and curious yet friendly with people, the Wire Fox Terrier investigates when quarry disappears underground.
descriptions.VBO:0201427: Attentive in the field and attached to its people, the Griffon points game and follows wounded quarry.
descriptions.VBO:0201428: Affectionate and sensitive, the Wirehaired Vizsla stays in touch with its handler while searching and pointing.
descriptions.VBO:0201435: Locally valued for courage and a keen nose, Xiasi dogs hunted in Guizhou and kept watch at home.
descriptions.VBO:0201436: Calm and quiet but watchful of arrivals, the Xolo also carries a deep role in pre-Hispanic Mexican belief.
descriptions.VBO:0201442: Bold at work and sociable with people, Yakutian Laikas partnered in Arctic sled travel and hunting.
descriptions.VBO:0201448: Alert and spirited, the Yorkshire Terrier still notices movement quickly, echoing its English rodent-chasing roots.
descriptions.VBO:0201454: Lively and self-assured, the German Pinscher brings even attention to activity and an old farm-watchdog tradition.
descriptions.VBO:0201455: Playful and sociable, the French Bulldog stays involved with its people, a companion shaped in Parisian working circles.
